title: Descript + ManyChat: My 4-Tool Stack
caption:
Why does your tool stack keep failing?

This is what worked. Steal the system:
1️⃣ Descript — edit video by editing the transcript — delete a word, delete the clip
2️⃣ ManyChat — Instagram DM + comment automation — turns a comment into a conversation
3️⃣ ChatGPT — the generalist — best used with a saved system prompt, not one-off asks
4️⃣ OpusClip — turns one long video into dozens of captioned short clips with virality scores

Try it and tell me what happens.
